svg.title: How Frankenstein works
svg.desc: A compiled game whose source is lost goes into a loop: Diggers write C, the referee compiles it and compares bytes, the Checker re-runs every claim, and two labs (SubQ Snap and Gemini) screen each match for fakes. SubQ Snap's judgment steers the loop. Rejected work goes back to the Diggers; accepted matches teach the habit library in MongoDB. The output is a rebuilt ROM with an identical SHA-1 that plays on a phone.
svg.text: Agents write it. A compiler proves it.
THE LOOP · EVERY FUNCTION, EVERY ATTEMPT
